skills.description: Generates a personalized travel plan from a user's destination, travel dates, group size, and demographic profile (gender and age). Researches similar travel guides on the web, integrates them, and produces a categorized cost/budget breakdown (transport, lodging, food, tickets), food and lodging recommendations matched to budget and preferences, common tourist-trap warnings with avoidance tips, and other notes (weather, safety, documents/visa). It also creates a travel Todo checklist (packing list plus check-in task list) and a visual travel journal (手账) as an HTML file styled to the traveler's age and taste, including a trip timeline, daily highlights, and blank handwriting areas. This skill should be used whenever a user asks to plan a trip, make a travel itinerary, 写旅游攻略 / 行程规划, build a travel budget, or create a travel journal / 手账 / packing list.
